outcome: Neonatal composite outcome (5-minute Apgar score <7, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, respiratory distress syndrome, necrotizing enterocolitis, seizures, intracranial hemorrhage, periventricular or intraventricular hemorrhage, neonatal sepsis, neonatal intensive care unit admission, and neonatal death)
cohort: 228,438 deliveries in 19 United States hospitals from 2002 to 2008. Inclusion criteria: women with viable, singleton gestations. Exclusion criteria: stillbirths and gestations with severe congenital anomalies.
finding: Women with antepartum anemia experienced increased rates of severe maternal morbidity and other serious adverse outcomes, even after adjusting for confounders.
